invite.title: Invitation to a usability study
invite.intro: You have been invited to help evaluate this platform as part of a research study. Participation is voluntary.
invite.data: We record, only while a task is active: time on task, whether it was completed, use of Help and instructor assistance, and technical errors.
invite.notCollected: We do not record your credential contents, evidence, or what you type. Results are exported under a pseudonym.
invite.voluntary: You can decline or stop at any time without any effect on your use of the platform.
invite.skip: You do not have to finish all tasks; you can skip them and come back later.

drawer.title: Platform testing
drawer.intro: You don't have to finish all tasks — you can skip them and return later.

panel.label: Task
panel.selfReport: I believe I completed the task
panel.serverNote: This task is verified automatically from what you did on the platform.

help.requested: Your need for help has been recorded. Contact your instructor directly — the platform does not send them a message. The task timer remains paused.
help.received: Instructor assistance has been recorded. When ready, select “Back to the task”.
help.error: Help could not be saved successfully. Please try again.
help.opened: The manual opened in a new tab. The task timer is paused while you read.

finish.participantIdNote: Your evaluation participant ID. Copy it and enter it in the ID field of the USE questionnaire — it lets us link answers to task results without your name or email.
finish.idCopyFailed: Copy failed — please write the ID down manually.

admin.title: Evaluation
admin.description: Task-based usability testing for selected earner accounts. Off by default.
admin.name: Name
admin.versionFallback: No scenarios exist for this version – v1 will be used.
admin.searchEarner: Search earners by name or email
admin.exportError: The report could not be prepared. Please try again.
admin.dataNote: Skipped and not-started scenarios are reported as not assessed, never as failures. Verified and self-reported outcomes are listed separately.
admin.verifiedRateTip: Verified success rate = verified / (verified + partial + failed) attempts.
admin.notAssessedTip: Attempts without an objective outcome (no server evidence or skipped). Not counted as failure.
admin.medianTip: Median active time of completed attempts; N = number of completed attempts included.
admin.helpRateTip: Attempts with at least one manual opening / all started attempts.
admin.instructorRateTip: Attempts with instructor help received / all started attempts. Requests shown separately.
